title: Reconcile Grappled exclusion occurrence count in condition relationship design
description: Reconcile docs/design/condition-condition-relationships.md with the committed Grappled mechanics shape. The design says one conditionEndsWhen condition leaf on condition:grappled is excluded, but the importer emits two conditionEndsWhen effects (grappler-incapacitated and removed-from-grappler-reach), each with condition: grappled. Both correctly resolve to excluded under the approved relation table. Update the design evidence/count wording and ensure the permanent committed-pack test continues to assert both self-reference leaves without changing relationship semantics.
notes: Discovered while implementing eshyra-o9bd.19.3.4.3.1; implementation commit 12b32c18 covers both emitted occurrences and asserts their self-reference.
close_reason: Duplicate of eshyra-0p5j; retain eshyra-0p5j as the design wording follow-up.
